title: console lists: the conditions a user builds in the Filter panel, the sort and the toolbar grouping are not in the URL, so a filtered list cannot be shared as a link
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui maintainer (console / records owner) — a decision on the list surface's URL contract. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed on the maintainer's word: 「视图、筛选、排序、分组都写进 URL；临时界面（面板、弹窗）不写进 URL。「立卡」」.

## Maintainer quick-read

Should a list's own toolbar state — the conditions a user builds in the Filter panel, the search term, the sort and the toolbar grouping — be reflected in the URL, the way the view tab and the quick filters already are? Today a list someone filtered, sorted and grouped cannot be sent as a link.

## What is in the URL today (read in source on main; the Filter-panel half measured)

- View tab: the route `/:objectName/view/:viewId` — in the URL.
- Author-declared quick filters (`userFilters`): `uf_*` params via `userFilterUrlState` — in the URL, shareable.
- Drill filters: `filter[<field>]=<value>` read through `drillUrlFilters` — in the URL.
- Filter-panel conditions and the search term: `localStorage`, per user, object and view (`listFilterStorage`). Deliberate: it survives in-app navigation, which a bare nav link would lose (objectstack-ai/objectui#2294, objectstack-ai/objectui#4155). Measured: Priority = Urgent survived a reload while the address bar stayed `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`.
- Sort (with density, hidden fields, column order): written to the view's stored row through `persistViewPatch` → `updateViewConfig`.
- Toolbar grouping: `ListView` component state only (`groupingConfig`); nothing stores it (read in source).

## Why it matters

"The urgent tasks, grouped by assignee" cannot be a link in chat or a bookmark. ADR-0054 (UI testability contract) invariant C3 already lists the *active filter set* among the navigable surfaces whose state should be URL-reflectable, and ADR-0047's open question 1 asks the same for interface-mode filters.

## Out of scope

The original ask also said to keep panels and dialogs out of the URL. Reading the source showed that is deliberate: `useUrlOverlay` puts the palette, record drawer, action dialog and wizard step in the URL under ADR-0054 C3 (deep links, back/forward, automation), with `replace` writes so no history piles up. This card does not ask to change it.

## Options

- **A** — mirror the Filter-panel group, search, sort and grouping into URL params (replace writes, no history entries) alongside today's persistence: the URL wins when present (an opened link), storage restores when absent. A param family of its own — the list route deliberately executes only the equality arm of `filter[...]`.
- **B** — a *Copy link to this list* action that serializes the current state on demand; the address bar stays as it is.
- **C** — status quo.

## Recommendation

A: it closes the C3 gap for the list surface and keeps the existing restore-after-navigation behaviour.

## Environment

Source read on objectui `main` at `82500a7` and objectstack `main` at `033e5c53`. Live observations are from the 2026-10-07 browser QA pass: `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` (objectstack `879bd38c`), console from objectui `179f6fe9`, Chromium 141 at 1440×900, signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai`.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *list view filter sort grouping state in URL shareable link*: 0 hits (0 open, 0 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *FilterBuilder advanced filter persisted localStorage not in URL cannot share filtered list*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *toolbar group by lost on reload grouping not persisted*: 3 hits (0 open, 3 closed).
- Related, not the same ask:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#2294 (closed) — list filters lost on page switch; its fix is the localStorage persistence this card keeps
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
